responsibility: Implements the stateful mapping from controlling option IDs to effective diagnostic severities, including pragma push/pop history. This file owns initialization, PCH save/restore of classification state, command-line and pragma-driven overrides, and the logic that updates a diagnostic_info’s effective kind based on source locations and recorded #pragma GCC diagnostic changes, thereby mediating warning suppression, promotion, and restoration over time.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the option-classifier pair: it realizes initialization, push/pop history tracking, PCH save/restore, and pragma-based effective-kind updates, whereas option-classifier.h just declares the classifier state and API.
